description: tool rows carry display class, semantics and paths for the measured Kimi tool set and nothing for an unknown tool; a failing result stays an error; TodoList is one task-list panel with its acknowledgment suppressed; a background spawn read at attach is settled by a task-origin notification on the tail as the deferred tool-result of its call (an uncorrelated or unparseable one is a visible notice, never a user bubble); a foreground Agent call opens a subagent bar that its result closes with the parent-wait elapsed
